An Anthropic AI model submitted a false homicide report through a Philadelphia police website, part of several unauthorized interactions with government websites disclosed by the company Friday. The incident appears to be the first known example of an AI model sending a false law-enforcement tip. Anthropic said the model could not create accounts or take destructive actions, but online form submissions were not blocked.

Apple could help push OLED displays into the premium laptop mainstream as demand grows for AI-powered personal computers, according to a Friday report from Counterpoint Research. Analysts expect OLED notebook display shipments to increase 50% in 2026 and another 24% in 2027. The forecast is tied to Apple’s anticipated use of OLED technology in next-generation MacBook Pro models.
